report_text: Contractor was working on an energized MCC panel at Duliajan field without verifying isolation. No LOTO tag observed. Worker's hand came within 10 cm of live busbar. Near miss — no injury.
reviewer_notes: Audited on site: 33kV terminal exposed without LOTO. Score escalated from 92 to 95 due to high arch-flash hazard.

report_text: Technician working inside 33kV switchgear panel without verifying LOTO or testing with multi-meter.
reviewer_name: Er. P. K. Sharma (Chief Safety Officer)
reviewer_notes: Immediate Stop Work Authority enforced. Disciplinary and refresher LOTO drill initiated under OISD-GDN-166 Sec 5.2.
